harmonic_extraction.primary: uniform-weight complex spherical-harmonic least squares on unmasked HEALPix pixel centres
harmonic_extraction.reason: removes monopole/dipole jointly and reduces leakage from l=4..10 through the 1 percent mask

octupole_test.score: F3=max_R |<u3, R*T3>|^2 for normalized l=3 states

quadrupole_holdout.template: D_s H3 for a tetrahedral vertex s after the l3-only orientation fit
quadrupole_holdout.discrete_vertex_policy: evaluate all four symmetry-equivalent vertices and report max squared normalized overlap F2; the same max-over-four rule is used in null calibration

numerical_search.observed_orientation: deterministic differential-evolution plus local refinement with fixed seed
numerical_search.rotation_convention: right-handed SO(3); world template H_R(n)=H3(R^T n)

null_diagnostics.l3: isotropic Gaussian real l=3 states; orientation-fit statistic calibrated with the same finite rotation bank/search policy
null_diagnostics.l2: isotropic Gaussian real l=2 states; max-over-four vertex statistic
null_diagnostics.p_values: diagnostic unless simulation count and numerical convergence are reported

verdicts.continuous_scale: separate from morphology and already evaluated

forbidden: lower fit_lmax because a result improves
choose one of four vertices before reporting all four/max policy
use one frequency as primary after seeing results
